title: When Jesus to the Jordan Came
description: When Jesus to the Jordan Came in Tonic Solfa to WINCHESTER NEW, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Morningland (Paisley, 1911), headed “Various”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Long Metre (8.8.8.8), and this page sets them to WINCHESTER NEW; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: When Je-sus to the Jor-dan came To hon-our there the rite di-vine, Then, to the world, His aw-ful claim Was wit-nessed by the God-head Trine.

lines: When Jesus to the Jordan came
To honour there the rite divine,
Then, to the world, His awful claim
Was witnessed by the Godhead Trine.
From heaven the Father's voice declared
And lo! the Holy Ghost appeared,
And wore the likeness of a Dove.
Thrice holy, Jesus Christ, art Thou,
By Father and by Spirit blessed;
We see Thee at the Jordan now,
And hear Thy Godhead there expressed.
Now to the Father glory be,
And to the Son beloved by God,
In heaven and all the earth abroad.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Morningland (1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Morningland; set to WINCHESTER NEW by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
